description: Squire gets to know the Squire owner through a guided first conversation and keeps a profile, a house style and a learning log. The Squire owner names their Squire and gives it a personality, which it keeps. Teaching when asked is part of the guided first conversation's criterion; plain words and short answers are reviewed behaviour, not criteria.
title: Gets to know you: profile, house style, learning, teach-me mode, name and personality
